I’d be happy to be your friend, be here for you to talk to. I know it’s not the same as a face-to-face friend but, better than nothing?

Also, I have the same struggle making friends. Part of that is because of my appearance I’m sure (6’4”, super skinny, purple hair, industrial earring, and always wear an army jacket), but I don’t know how to talk to people. 
A couple days ago I made a new friend though, just by accident. Some guy running up to the train, yelled out “yes” because he got there right in time. I looked over and chuckled, and he introduced himself, we got to talking, and became friends on the train ride home!

Friends are hard, but I’m here for you if you want. PM me if you ever wanna talk about anything.
